Metro Detroit, Ann Arbor, Flint, Battle Creek and Jackson areas

notes: Scout 2026-11-26: read the thesmithfamilyfarm.net homepage, Story, Real Food (products), Shop Now (farm-store-online), FAQ, Farm-to-Home delivery schedule and Contact pages, all through WebFetch summaries, so the quote (FAQ answer to a feeding question) came from a summary, not raw text; Verifier: recheck the exact wording. Products page labels the beef and lamb GRASS FED & FINISHED (winter hay); pork, chicken, turkey and eggs are raised outdoors with non-GMO grains and pasture. Story page says the family made relationships with nearby farms to source food from; it does not say which products, so check whether any meat is bought in (would go in resold_note). Free home delivery on set days (Lansing area every other week, Detroit area 1 to 2 times a month, Grand Rapids monthly) and homepage says it delivers within 200 miles of the farm; FAQ mentions pickup at the farm. No shipping, bulk shares, phone or street address on the site (email only). The Shop Now page is an embedded store whose products did not come through, so check it for quarter or half options. Also sells maple syrup and coffee.
